question: What is the average total quantity across all final packaging combinations, considering only the leaf-level items within each combination after fully expanding any nested packaging relationships?
sql:
-- Now the question asks for "average total quantity across all final packaging combinations"
-- So average of 864, 720, 960, 1240
SELECT AVG(total_leaf_qty) AS avg_total_quantity
FROM (
    WITH RECURSIVE packaging_tree AS (
        SELECT 
            p.id AS root_id,
            p.id AS current_id,
            1 AS level,
            CAST(1 AS BIGINT) AS total_qty
        FROM packaging p
        WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
        
        UNION ALL
        
        SELECT 
            pt.root_id,
            pr.contains_id AS current_id,
            pt.level + 1,
            pt.total_qty * pr.qty AS total_qty
        FROM packaging_tree pt
        JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pr.packaging_id = pt.current_id
    ),
    leaf_items AS (
        SELECT id FROM packaging
        WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations)
    )
    SELECT 
        pt.root_id,
        SUM(pt.total_qty) AS total_leaf_qty
    FROM packaging_tree pt
    JOIN leaf_items li ON li.id = pt.current_id
    WHERE pt.level > 1
    GROUP BY pt.root_id
)
